**Not in this slice:** any edit to the roadmap or decisions (after v1, `ui.slicer-tui`).

## Why

The owner needs to see each project's roadmap: the ranked queue, what is ready, and the goals, without leaving ork (PROJECT.md goal 1). This slice is the Roadmap screen only, and it stays read-only; editing waits for after v1 (scope.v1, ui.slicer-tui).

The Decisions screen moves to its own slice, S59, by owner choice. The current S12 text covers both, so its Files and tests for decisions are removed here.

The view bar is static text today (internal/tui/view.go:168-171) and only Overview can be shown. Decision 120 (ui.views, decided) makes Tab and Shift+Tab switch views (Overview, Roadmap, Decisions). This slice adds the view switch with the Roadmap view.

## Failing tests

- TestRoadmapListsItemsInSlicerOrder: rows follow `slicer list` order and show readiness, status, size, effort and claim.
- TestRoadmapReadinessFromDeps: a row is ready only when it is in the `slicer deps` unblocked list, is open and has a slice. A claim is shown when the item output carries one (Open in Implement).
- TestRoadmapGoalsHeadTheScreen: goals from `slicer goals --json` head the screen; a goals error shows verbatim and keeps the list (slicer s380).
- TestRoadmapDetailLoadsOnEnter: Enter loads the item detail, pending until item.show returns; Esc returns.
- TestRoadmapWritesNothing: no key on the screen calls a write method on the Live fake.
- TestTabReachesTheRoadmapView: with the Roadmap view built, tab from Overview goes through the built views in order and reaches Roadmap (S58 owns the key handling).
- TestDashboardDocsListTheNavigationKeys (existing, tui_test.go:698) passes with the new keys.
- Golden views at 100x30, colour and monochrome.
